SEEDANCE 2.5｜Water Human-Shape Wall Challenge

【Style】Live-Action Water Game Show, bright saturated colors, midsummer noon natural light, real broadcast-grade cinematography, fast editing, light comedy rhythm, real gravity and water physics, 4K HD
【Duration】15 seconds
【Aspect Ratio】16:9 landscape
【Language】Chinese male voice-over narration, the protagonist has no formal lines, only breathing, exertion sounds and a short scream before falling into the water; no subtitles
【Scene】A large outdoor water game show arena, an orange narrow challenge platform set up in the center of a blue swimming pool, at the end of the platform is a light blue thick human-shape wall panel moving forward at constant speed along a hidden track; in the center of the wall panel is a crab deep-squat human-shape hole with "head centered, both elbows spread horizontally, hands holding the head, legs spread wide in a squat". Opposite the pool is a semicircular grandstand full of spectators, covered above by a large white sunshade canopy.

【Character Card】
@Image1 named "Xia Yan", water game show challenger. The character's face, body shape, hairstyle, makeup, clothing and accessories fully inherit from the reference image, no appearance elements added or modified.
Character goal: before the moving human-shape wall arrives, quickly understand the hole's pose and get her body through.
Performance trajectory: confident entrance → brief shock after seeing the challenge → hurriedly adjusting pose → thinking she has succeeded → realizing the size doesn't fit → pushed off the platform into the water by the wall → after surfacing, glaring at the camera unconvinced.
Performance style: leaning toward real game-show reactions, not deliberately cute, not exaggerated from the first second; all expression changes must be triggered in sequence by the wall's movement, body contact and the falling result.

[00:00-00:02.00] Shot 1: Level 2 begins (Close-up Hook)
Frontal close-up: Xia Yan stands in the center of the orange platform, the pool and the light blue human-shape wall panel behind her. The camera uses a medium telephoto to compress the background, the grandstand slightly out of focus.

[00:00-00:00.80]
Xia Yan looks straight at the camera, maintaining a confident, composed smile, shoulders naturally relaxed. In the background comes the "click" of the mechanical device starting up and a low motor hum.

【Chinese male voice-over】"Level 2, begin!" ("第二关，开始！")

The narration voice is bright and powerful, like a live game-show host, must not use a news-anchor tone.

[00:00-00:00.80-00:02.00]
The mechanical sound gradually approaches. Xia Yan's smile freezes, eyes suddenly widen, lips naturally part into a small circle; she first looks at the camera, then quickly moves her eyes to observe the challenge wall behind her.

The reaction must not appear early, it must change from confident to surprised only after the mechanical sound starts.

【Chinese male voice-over】"This time it's—Super Crab Squat!" ("这次是——超级螃蟹蹲！")

"Super Crab Squat" raises the volume and stretches the ending, paired with a short game-show brass sound effect.

[00:02.00-00:05.00] Shot 2: Understanding the pose, getting into position (Wide Shot → Rear Three-quarter)
Hard cut to wide shot: fully showing the orange platform, pool, light blue human-shape wall panel and grandstand. The human-shape wall slowly moves toward Xia Yan along a straight track from the far end of the platform, staying vertical the whole time, at a steady speed.

[00:02.00-00:03.00]
Xia Yan quickly turns to face the human-shape hole, first scanning the hole's outline up and down, confirming the positions of the head, both elbows, torso and legs.

She jogs two steps closer to the positioning area in front of the wall panel, her feet contacting the platform realistically, no slipping, no teleporting.

[00:03.00-00:05.00]
Rear three-quarter camera: Xia Yan raises both hands to the back of her head, fingers interlocked, both elbows opening to the left and right; feet quickly spreading to both sides, knees outward, body center of gravity gradually sinking.

【Chinese male voice-over】"Legs apart, lower your center of gravity, hands on your head!" ("双腿打开，重心压低，双手抱头！")

The narration rhythm syncs with the movements:

"Legs apart" corresponds to feet moving to both sides;
"Lower your center of gravity" corresponds to the body entering a deep squat;
"Hands on your head" corresponds to hands interlocking behind the head.

The body movements must be completed in sequence, forbidden for the three movements to suddenly appear in the same frame.

[00:05.00-00:09.00] Shot 3: Pose is right, size is wrong (Symmetrical Front Shot)
Cut to a symmetrical wide shot facing the wall panel. The camera shoots Xia Yan through the human-shape hole, her head, arms, torso and legs respectively aligned with the corresponding openings.

[00:05.00-00:06.20]
Xia Yan keeps hands on head and wide-stance deep squat, adjusting her steps left and right, then moving her body a few centimeters toward the center of the hole.

She first looks down to check her feet position, then raises her eyes to look at the approaching wall panel. Lips lightly pressed together, breathing quickening.

[00:06.20-00:07.50]
The wall panel continues moving forward at constant speed along the track. Xia Yan lowers her center of gravity even more, letting her elbows and legs fit as close as possible to the hole edges.

She briefly closes her eyes and exerts effort, shoulders slightly raised; when she reopens her eyes, pupils dilate, lips open, discovering the hole is tighter than expected.

【Chinese male voice-over】"The pose is very standard—" ("姿势很标准——")

The first half of the sentence is excited in tone, as if announcing she is about to succeed.

[00:07.50-00:09.00]
The wall panel gets closer and closer to her. She holds the pose not daring to move, only slightly moving her eyes to observe the hole edges on both sides.

The hole edges gradually approach her elbows and legs, but contact has not yet occurred. The confidence on her face disappears bit by bit, mouth slightly open, breathing pauses for half a beat.

【Chinese male voice-over】"But this hole... seems a bit small!" ("可这个洞……好像小了点！")

After "but this hole" there is a pause of about 0.3 seconds; "a bit small" lowers the volume, with an obvious sense of foreboding.

The background music pauses for one heavy beat here, leaving only the wall's mechanical sound and the audience's gasps.

[00:09.00-00:10.50] Shot 4: Didn't get through (Side Shot / Physical Comedy)
Cut to a side medium-wide shot of the platform, simultaneously seeing the human-shape wall, Xia Yan and the pool edge behind her.

[00:09.00-00:09.50]
The wall panel reaches Xia Yan's position. The hole edges first lightly touch the outer sides of her body, she immediately realizes she cannot fully get through, eyes widen, hands release from behind her head, palms forward searching for support.

The reaction must be triggered by contact, forbidden to stand up early or lean back early.

【Chinese male voice-over】"Oh no, didn't get stuck in!" ("糟了，没卡进去！")

[00:09.50-00:10.50]
The wall panel continues forward at its original speed, Xia Yan, unable to pass through the hole, is steadily pushed toward the platform edge.
